# forgebase_org (Data Source)

Looks up an organization the caller can see, by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forgebase_org" "acme" {
  slug = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docgen; do not edit by hand (run `go generate ./...`) -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Organization slug.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization id.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `realm_id` (String) Realm.
